text: {"summary":"Task: repair Python 3.11 two-module project; entrypoint engine.solve(data). Return complete replacement contents for allowlisted engine.py and rules.py; no third-party libraries. Public requirements through stage 3 (8 checks, public_pass): compute each event gross=price*quantity (default 1); discount_bp clamp to [0,10000], apply to gross and round division by 10000 using requested rounding (floor or half_up; half-up = (n+5000)//10000). Apply tax_bp (default 0) to the rounded net, independently round using same mode, add to net, then negate final amount only for kind='refund'. Aggregate by account|currency (defaults default|USD), no conversion, preserve keys for zero totals.\nDeduplicate events by id: greatest revision wins; ties use last input position. Do not assume input is chronological by revision. Events without id are unique as anonymous:<original_position>. Aggregate only selected events. Preserve each event’s original index for anonymous IDs.\nCheckpoint artifact currently handles requirements 1–5: engine.py imports amount, aggregates using account/currency defaults; rules.py implements clamped discounts, net rounding, tax rounding, then refund negation. _round_bp uses floor only when mode=='floor', otherwise half-up; public tests so far use half_up. It does not implement requirement 6 deduplication, so still needs repair. No trial notes beyond supplied artifact/history; public passes are provisional. Task is stage 3 of 4; later requirements remain unrevealed, and task contract says implement all requirements revealed so far. Exact artifacts and public test vectors were supplied in source history; no additional values/order requirements."}
